tables.name: communications
columns: source_scope_id TEXT NOT NULL FK communication_source_scopes
identity_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK in PROVIDER_STABLE,FALLBACK,IDENTITY_COLLISION
chronology_known INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK in 0,1
direction TEXT NOT NULL CHECK in RECEIVED,SENT,UNKNOWN
body_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK in TEXT,HTML,RTF_DERIVED_TEXT,NONE
content_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK in RETAINED,PURGED
content_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK content_revision>=1
constraints: provider stable identity unique only within source scope when not null
indexes: UNIQUE PARTIAL ux_comm_provider_identity(source_scope_id,provider_identity_kind,provider_identity_digest) WHERE provider_identity_digest IS NOT NULL AND identity_state='PROVIDER_STABLE'

tables.name: communication_identity_aliases
columns: communication_id TEXT NOT NULL FK communications

tables.name: communication_participants
columns: communication_id TEXT NOT NULL FK communications
role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK in FROM,SENDER,TO,CC,BCC,REPLY_TO,OTHER
ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ordinal>=0

tables.name: communication_attachments
columns: communication_id TEXT NOT NULL FK communications
ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ordinal>=0
size_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK size_bytes>=0
chunk_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK chunk_count>=0

tables.name: communication_attachment_chunks
columns: communication_attachment_id TEXT NOT NULL FK communication_attachments
chunk_index INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK chunk_index>=0

derived_objects.name: communication_search_fts
derived_objects.content: contentless rebuildable rows keyed by communication_id; indexes only RETAINED subject/body normalized text
derived_objects.purge: delete FTS row in same UnitOfWork as content purge

rules: all known application instants persist as canonical UTC whole seconds; imported/source precision and chronology provenance are preserved separately and never by storing application chronology in milliseconds
no communications row is created for an unmatched transient message unless it is retained for an explicit collision/correction review protected hold
content_state=PURGED requires subject/body/participants/attachments/search material removed while immutable identity/minimized evidence survives in retention tables
attachment chunks are streamed and never copied into audit/job/diagnostic payloads
